headings.hierarchy_rule: The jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.

rules: The 'Tinted Grey' Rule: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. Tint neutral greys slightly blue for cool, or orange for warm.
Color is Function Only: 95% of UI monochrome. Color exists only to guide action.

surfaces.use_case: Sticky Headers, Floating Map Controls (Student Info Card)
surfaces.implementation: bg-white/70 dark:bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 dark:border-white/10 shadow-sm

surfaces.use_case: Admin Dashboard, Data Tables, Stats Cards
surfaces.implementation: Flat background, 1px subtle border border-border, no shadow. Hover: -translate-y-1 shadow-lg border-primary/50

misc: Custom Scrollbars: no gutter, stylized thumb.
Interactive Elements: Layered shadows, nested radii.

grids.protocol: MODE B: High Density Grid (For Dashboards/Analytics)
technical_rules: Direct Children Only: Grid items MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Use align-items: start and align-self: stretch to prevent jagged bottoms.

general: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-6, p-8, p-12.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

specific_pages.landing: Asymmetrical layout, high visual impact, overlapping elements, no standard Vercel look. Hero overlay max bg-black/50.
specific_pages.admin_dashboard: Strict grid hierarchy, dense/compact spacing, cardless or max 8px border-radius.
specific_pages.driver_mobile: Single column stack, massive START/END buttons, high contrast for outdoor visibility.
specific_pages.student_tracking: Fullscreen Leaflet map (z-index base), floating glassmorphism card (z-index high) at bottom with route ETA.

rules: Never use 'transition: all'. Explicitly state properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease).
Hover states on all interactive elements. Hover state color must be a lighter hue of active state color.
Entrance animations (staggered) for lists using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 (normal text), 3:1 (large). ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive/key elements MUST include data-testid attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.

icons.usage: Use consistently for navigation, dashboard widgets, and map actions.

3d libraries.strategy: Not recommended for this specific use case as clarity and 2D mapping (Leaflet) are priorities for real-time tracking.
3d libraries.map_library: react-leaflet (2D interactive tracking) with OpenStreetMap. Apply CSS filters to OSM tiles to match dark mode if needed.

image_urls.description: Yellow and black modern city bus on road

instructions_to_main_agent: IMPORTANT: You have .js and .jsx files, not .tsx files. Follow JS guidelines.
Create a theme toggle (Light/Dark). Make Dark Mode the primary vibe for Admin (logistics/tech look) and Light Mode for Student/Landing.
Ensure Leaflet maps are styled cleanly without default cluttered controls. Apply CSS filters to map tiles in dark mode to match theme.
WebSocket integration must have distinct UI states (connecting/connected/error) using Toasts (sonner) or Badges.
Implement simulation mode explicitly for Nagpur, India. Ensure markers auto-update without page reload.
Driver dashboard MUST have massive tap targets for START/END trip buttons as they will be used on bumpy roads.
Adhere strictly to Shadcn but strip 'Vercel-look'. Make tables dense and borders crisp.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
Examine existing components to understand the project's component patterns before creating new ones.
Use 'sonner' for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it. Example: Dropdown with transparent background.
